## Market Structure & Technical Context

The XenosFinance Elliott Wave engine flags an active Wave 3 bearish impulse on the H4 timeframe, providing elite confluence for continuation toward the 1831.2260 target. The market is demonstrating classic turbulent impulsive behavior (Reynolds 71.19), indicating aggressive institutional participation on the sell side.

Technical indicators show intense downside pressure: the RSI is suppressed at 33.4%, signaling sustained weakness without immediate exhaustion, while the EMA20 (2088.0425) trends well beneath the declining EMA50 (2157.9272). With an H4 ATR of 32.6814, the stop-loss at 2113.5225 provides a safe structural buffer above the flag boundary while maintaining an exceptional 1:3.1 risk-to-reward ratio.

## Key Levels

- **Resistance**: 2100.4499 (Bear flag upper boundary and structural invalidation point)
- **Support**: 2005.8300 (Immediate psychological and swing low support floor)

## Invalidation Level
